div.p:
A SINGLE ENTRY POINT THAT FRONTS A SET OF BACKEND SERVICES. IT
OWNS CROSS-CUTTING CONCERNS — AUTHENTICATION, RATE LIMITING,
REQUEST ROUTING, RESPONSE AGGREGATION — SO NO INDIVIDUAL SERVICE
HAS TO, AND SO CLIENTS NEED TO KNOW ONLY ONE ADDRESS.

ul.li:
SD-NOTES/MEMORY/SD.D2 AND SD-NOTES/GENERALMOTORS/SD.D2 — AN
EXPLICIT API_GATEWAY FRONTS THE CONFIGURATOR, STREAMING, AND
ASSET SERVICES FOR BROWSER / MOBILE / VR / KIOSK CLIENTS.

SD-NOTES/TOOLS/MCP.D2 — THE MCP SERVER IS A GATEWAY THAT
NORMALISES MANY TOOL AND DATA SOURCES BEHIND ONE PROTOCOL.
